decisions.action: Current POWO separately accepts both species but records a 2006 alternative that cited P. gattingeri as P. philadelphicum. Preserve source-dependent historical identification, do not collapse records without vouchers.

decisions.source_name: Historical Panicum capillare sensu lato specimens and learner images
decisions.action: Accepted-name and synonym mapping does not verify individual photographs or historical specimen identities among P. capillare, P. hillmanii, P. gattingeri and P. philadelphicum. Do not infer rank or hybrid ancestry for any image. No images inspected or changed in taxonomy lane.

source_notes.POWO_WCVP: 2026-10-24 live accepted-name and synonym checks; Kew POWO/WCVP species pages are the basis of all nomenclatural mappings.
source_notes.USACE_NWPL: USACE National Wetland Plant List Panicum capillare PACA6; page last modified 2026-02-07; independent synonym corroboration.
source_notes.primary_monograph: Zuloaga & Aliscioni (2023), Panicum (Poaceae), Flora Neotropica 124, DOI 10.1007/978-3-031-33768-0. Bibliographic reference only: paywalled species-level pages not independently inspected.
